subject: Security review kickoff & scope clarification - Orchard Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@orchardhealth.com>
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Security review kickoff & scope clarification - Orchard Health

Hi Lena —

Thanks again for the intro call earlier today. Quick follow-up & proposed next steps to keep momentum on the security/compliance track so we can get to procurement and an eventual PO: 

1) Recap of what we heard on the call:
- Primary use case: patient-facing recommendations and analytics; integration with Orchard EHR for de-identified sync.
- Key decision criteria called out: data residency & encryption, audit logs, uptime/latency SLAs, and SOC 2 / HIPAA posture.

2) Asks from your side to help scope the review:
- Can you confirm the list of internal stakeholders we should engage (economic buyer, security lead, legal, procurement)?
- Please share the security questionnaire your team uses (if you have one) and the systems in-scope for the review (e.g., integrations, DBs, analytics infra).
- Target timeline: ideally have the questionnaire back within 1-2 weeks so procurement can start drafting terms. Is that feasible?

3) Our proposed owners & timing: 
- I will coordinate the process (Marissa Cole, Redwood).
- Rishi Malhotra (cc’d on follow-ups) will lead the questionnaire responses and pull in infra/security SMEs as needed.
- Neha Kapoor will help coordinate procurement requirements and pricing questions.

If you can share the questionnaire and stakeholder mapping, we’ll kick off an internal intake and propose a timeline for completion.

Thanks — happy to set a short kickoff call with Rishi if that would help walk through any questions.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0192

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. Below is the stakeholder mapping and the initial scope we discussed. I'm attaching our standard questionnaire (Orchard_Security_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx) — it’s the one our security and procurement teams use for new vendors.

Stakeholder mapping:
- Economic buyer: Tom Hill, EVP Finance (tom.hill@orchardhealth.com) — will sign off on budget and vendor T&Cs.
- Security lead: Lena Ortiz, Head of Information Security (me) — technical security review and SOC2/controls validation.
- Legal: Priya Anand, General Counsel (priya.anand@orchardhealth.com) — contract redlines.
- Procurement: procurement@orchardhealth.com — PO and payment terms.

Systems in scope for the questionnaire / review:
- Redwood-hosted inference API endpoints used to serve recommendations.
- Integration layer connecting Redwood to Orchard EHR (patient sync).
- Any data storage or analytics buckets where Orchard data is persisted.
- Logging & monitoring systems for audit trails.

Timeline and next steps:
- Please have Rishi start the questionnaire; target to return a completed draft by Thu, Aug 5 so procurement can start a preliminary review.
- I can run a 30-min walkthrough of the questionnaire with Rishi next week if helpful — my calendar is open Wed/Thu mornings.
- We expect procurement to request SOC2 report and an enclave/network diagram as part of the intake.

Attaching: Orchard_Security_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx

Thanks — looking forward to the responses.

Best,

Lena Ortiz
Head of Information Security | Orchard Health
